summary: Checked all 10 retained estimates against the supplied 27-page PDF after reading the entire 531-line markdown conversion through the final reference. All recorded non-null statistics match the cited PDF pages (9, 11, and 15) and belong to the stated outcomes and partner conditions. Study-level people counts agree with PDF pages 4 and 7. Analysis-specific people counts are appropriately null: the story-diversity results print collaborating-pair counts, and counts were not inferred from pairs or degrees of freedom. The requested question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person, comparison-type, and uncertainty-basis codes are supported by the methods and results. The script warning for s1_aut_elaboration_unadjusted_ai_vs_human.measure is a false positive: creativity-codebook.md section 6 explicitly permits length for word or character count, and PDF page 9 reports words per idea (12.7 for Human-AI; 3.34 for Human-Human). Keep length; the validator enumeration omits a valid code. No clearly eligible outcome or contrast is missing under extraction rules 4-6. The originality and modeled elaboration effects adjust for DAT measured after collaboration and are correctly excluded. The AUT methods explicitly state that all models control for DAT; the abbreviated forward-flow results do not establish an unadjusted exception, so their documented exclusion is supported. The separately described exploratory story forward-flow coefficient is preserved as printed, with its conditional interpretation and reference-coding inference disclosed. Tables 1-3 were checked using PDF text; find_tables detected no tables on their pages. The supplied document has no appendix, and supplement-manifest.json lists no supplied SI files; this verification covers the supplied paper.
